full_prompt_en: A cinematic monochrome digital illustration shows two small walkers at the end of a dark forest path, facing a white opening filled with mist. One silhouette is taller and one shorter; they stand close together near the bottom center, made almost entirely from solid black shapes. The surrounding forest rises in exceptionally tall, straight trunks that climb beyond the upper frame. Most of the left side and the immediate foreground sink into deep charcoal darkness, while bright white light enters from the upper right and falls across the scene in broad oblique shafts. Wisps of haze and fine grain make those beams visible between the tree columns. A few faint leaves and branches interrupt the light high above, but many details disappear into the black mass. The path is nearly level, indicated by a slim irregular pale reflection and low uneven edge beneath the two figures. The palette contains only black, silver gray, and white; the drama depends on the size and placement of those tonal areas rather than color. The figures act as a scale marker for the enormous vertical forest and distant glow. Smooth mist transitions contrast with crisp tree silhouettes and a rough speckled surface that suggests damp air. The diagonal light beams pull the eye down toward the white center, then the tiny pair brings it to rest. The result is mysterious and quiet, with a sense of shared passage into space that remains unseen beyond the light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅电影感黑白数字插画呈现两名小小行人站在暗林小径尽头，面对充满薄雾的白色出口。一道剪影较高，一道较矮；他们在画面下方中央靠近站着，几乎全由实黑形状构成。周围森林立着特别高而直的树干，向上穿出画框。左侧大部和眼前前景沉入深炭黑，明亮白光则从右上进入，斜向宽光束铺过场景。细雾与微颗粒让光束在树柱之间可见。高处少量淡叶与枝条截断亮光，但许多细节消失在黑块中。小径近乎水平，由两人脚下细窄不规则的浅色反光和低低起伏边缘指出。调色只有黑、银灰与白；戏剧性取决于这些明暗面积的大小和位置，而不是色彩。两个人物为巨大竖向森林和远方辉光提供尺度。平滑雾色过渡对比清晰树木剪影以及暗示潮湿空气的粗颗粒表面。斜向光束把目光向下拉到白色中心，微小的人物组合再让视线停住。结果神秘而安静，带着两人共同走向尚未见到的亮处空间之感。
style_prompt_en: Cinematic monochrome digital illustration builds a scene from near-black masses, silver-gray haze, and a concentrated white opening. Tall, crisp vertical bands set a solemn rhythm against broad diagonal shafts of light. Most details disappear into shadow, while mist and fine speckled grain reveal beams and soften transitions near the luminous center. A small pair of dark marks at the lower center can supply scale and an emotional anchor without disrupting the large negative areas. The foreground remains a heavy matte charcoal, broken only by narrow irregular reflections. High contrast is strongest near the focal opening and eases gradually into gray atmospheric depth. Backlighting shapes silhouettes rather than illuminating their interiors. The composition draws the eye along light diagonals toward a bright central gap, then holds it with minimal small-scale detail. This restrained black-white structure feels mysterious, still, and spacious, with a subtly textured, poster-like finish.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感黑白数字插画由近乎全黑的色块、银灰薄雾和集中的白色开口构景。高而清晰的竖向带与宽阔斜光束构成庄严节奏。大多数细节隐入阴影，雾和细斑颗粒揭出光束并柔化亮中心附近的过渡。下方中央一组很小的暗笔痕可提供尺度与情绪锚点，不打断大片负空间。前景保持厚重哑光炭黑，只由细窄不规则反光划开。最强对比聚在焦点开口附近，渐渐缓入灰色空气深度。逆光塑造剪影，而非照亮其内部。构图沿斜光把目光带入中央亮缝，再用极少的小尺度细节让视线停住。这种克制的黑白结构神秘、静止、宽阔，具有微细纹理的海报式收束。
theme_en: Two small walkers entering a luminous misty forest
theme_zh: 两名小小行人走进发亮的雾林
name: Marko Manev
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
